exposure: Indications for preterm cesarean section (previous cesarean section, fetal distress)
cohort: The study included 410 mothers and 453 newborns who underwent preterm cesarean section.
finding: The most common indication for preterm cesarean section was previous cesarean section, and preterm cesarean sections increased maternal morbidities, though the cause of fetal complications was difficult to attribute solely to prematurity or the conditions leading to C-section.
mod_finding: Preterm cesarean sections were found to definitely increase maternal morbidities, with intraoperative hemorrhage being the most common maternal outcome and respiratory distress the most common fetal outcome.
